origin.description: Runs a function per chunk and discards its return value.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Runs a function per chunk and discards its return value.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
e <- new.env()
e$n <- 0
read_csv_chunked(I("a\n1\n2\n3"), SideEffectChunkCallback$new(function(x, pos) { e$n <- e$n + nrow(x) }), chunk_size = 2)
as.character(e$n)
